authority_rule: The live scope delta changes only its dependency closure and preserves unaffected commitments.

event_contract.after_state: Completion and alerts follow the returned dependency/approval/SLA policy while assignments, comments, audit history, and reports are preserved.
event_contract.before_state: Tasks can be marked done and alerts generated under provisional rules that ignore dependency closure and high-priority approval.

forbidden_shortcut: Do not ignore, double-apply, over-apply, or falsely close dependency_approval_sla_policy_added.
